name: Resilient REIT Limited
source: CRON 20261014: Resilient REIT Limited unaudited consolidated interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (results announcement, resilient.co.za), rand thousands. Printed: contractual rental revenue and recoveries 2032197, straight-lining adjustment (38666), total revenue 1993531, property operating expenses 736093, administrative expenses 82198, share-based payments 9934, profit before net finance costs 1528299, net finance costs 476388 (finance income 59550, finance costs 535938), profit before income tax 1051911, income tax 66511, profit for the period 985400 of which 931093 attributable to equity holders (non-controlling interests 54307), basic earnings per share 278.85 cents. Cost of Sales is the property operating expenses line, the basis already stored for FY2025. Operating Expenses is administrative expenses 82198 plus share-based payments 9934 plus the foreign exchange loss 69335 plus net impairments 51891 (88476 impairment of investment in associate less 40600 reversal of impairment of loans to associate plus 4015 impairment of loans receivable), which ties to the unit. Operating Profit (EBIT) is then the printed profit before net finance costs 1528299 less fair value adjustments 273223 less the share of profit of associates and joint venture 210996, which lands on 1044080 exactly. Gross Profit and Operating Profit (EBIT) are derived from those printed lines. Profit before income tax less income tax equals the printed profit for the period 985400. | source_url: https://admin.resilient.co.za/pdf_files/1786543282Results%20announcement%20-%20June%202026.pdf RECONCILE 20261014: an earlier pass had written a different column into the partner key of this file (ticker without the .JO suffix). The earlier pass had Operating Expenses 53346000 and Operating Profit (EBIT) 1203972000 and Net Finance Costs 535938000 (gross finance costs); the values now stored are the printed net finance costs and an operating profit that ties to the printed profit before net finance costs less fair value adjustments and less the share of profit of associates and joint venture, which is the subtotal Resilient itself prints.
